plan.title: Riverbend Canyon
plan.tagline: Paddle and hop down a red-rock canyon river to the waterfall pool.
plan.core_loop: Hop and leap from rock to rock and drifting raft down a winding canyon river, snatching lily seeds, timing the moving rafts, and dodging boulders and saws until you reach the waterfall pool.
controls: Space: hop (hold for a higher leap)
plan.win_condition: Reach the waterfall pool at the end of the canyon.
plan.lose_condition: Lose all 3 lives to boulders, saw blades or falling into the river.

mechanics.name: Frog Hop
mechanics.text: A springy leap and a quick dash let the frog clear wide rock gaps and drift rafts.

mechanics.name: Drift Rafts
mechanics.text: Log rafts bob and drift down the current - hop on and ride them across the wide water.

mechanics.name: Rip Current
mechanics.text: Ride a raft and the current pushes you downstream - time your hops off before it sweeps you past the rocks.

plan.art_direction: Warm late-afternoon red-rock canyon: banded rust-orange and ochre sandstone mesas, hoodoos and natural arches, a ribbon of turquoise river catching golden light, green lily pads and cacti for contrast. Toon shading with soft ink outlines and a gentle warm colour grade; light rakes across the terraced rock walls to read the bands.
concept_shots: The frog mid-leap between two mossy boulders over turquoise water, lily seeds spinning in a loose arc above the river, red-rock walls banded in rust and ochre behind.
A log raft drifting downstream with the frog balanced on it, a rip-current banner flashing, boulders patrolling the channel and a saw blade glinting in a rock slot ahead.
The goal: a wide waterfall spilling into a misty pool, the goal arch glowing at its base, the last stretch of stepping rocks leading up to it.

assets.sky: Golden late-afternoon desert sky: warm amber and peach horizon, a low bright sun, thin high cirrus clouds, faint haze over distant mesas.

features: Drifting log rafts (movers) to ride across the wide water
Patrolling boulders to hop over or avoid
Saw blades set in rock slots along the route
Spring pads on a couple of rocks for big leaps
Splash FX on every water touch plus a misty waterfall goal
Rip-current push rule while riding rafts
plan.mapping_notes: The pitch's space is a winding river through a red-rock canyon, which is exactly the canyon kind: its route runs start -> goal arch, it is built for platformers, and it already carries the red-rock mesas, arches, hoodoos, cacti, jump ramps and hazards. A frog is a native species, so the hero is a frog with a backpack (a little explorer's kit). The 'paddle and hop' fantasy maps to a platformer with a tuned springy jump, dash and a single air-hop, plus glide so long canyon leaps feel floaty. Rafts become Level movers the frog can hop onto and ride; the rip-current is a trigger->effect rule that speeds the frog while on a raft. The waterfall pool is the goal at the route's end (goal=true). Collect mode is not the win condition - reaching the pool wins - so mode is goal and the lily seeds are a bonus pickup along the way (18 of 24 to feel complete). Enemies are patrolling boulders (4) plus saw blades as hazards. The desert look preset matches the red-rock palette; a golden afternoon sky keeps the warm canyon mood.

result.summary: Riverbend Canyon: a frog with a backpack hops and paddles down a winding red-rock canyon river to the waterfall pool. Built on the scaffold using Level.compose for a hand-laid canyon river run (sand ground flooded by a turquoise water piece, stepping rocks, a rope bridge, stairs, pillars, a goal mesa, plus canyon-wall cliffs and a natural arch as scenery). The desert look + generated golden sky, lily-pad/hoodoo props and splat landmarks are all kept. Plan features added: 24 lily seeds (target 18, tag 'seed') along the route, 3 saw blades in rock slots, 2 spring pads, 4 drifting log rafts (raft movers), and 4 patrolling boulder enemies. All three signature mechanics are wired and verified firing: Frog Hop (tune: springy jump/dash/glide/air-jump), Drift Rafts (custom mechanic tracking raft riding + toast), and Rip Current (enter-zone rules at each raft boarding point that speed the frog + banner + boost sfx). I invented a twist mechanic, Lily Rush: every 6 lily seeds collected grants a highjump + speed burst with a banner, sfx and sparkles. HUD (arcade style) shows the lily-seed counter with the generated icon, lives, minimap and objective; title screen sells the fantasy. Autopilot verified: moves along the route, collects seeds (reached 21/18 in a 25s run, opening the goal), fires rules/powerups/mechanic banners, with 0 console errors throughout.
changes: Replaced Level.build with a composed canyon river run (Level.compose): water river, stepping platforms, bridge, stairs, pillars, goal mesa, canyon-wall cliffs and a natural arch
Tagged all collectibles as 'seed' and placed 24 lily seeds along the route (target 18)
Added plan hazards: 3 saw blades, 2 spring pads, and 4 patrolling boulder enemies along the route
Added 4 drifting log rafts as raft movers on the river
Added invisible rip-current trigger zones at each raft boarding point
Wired Rip Current as enter-zone rules (speed tune + banner + boost sfx) for each raft
Implemented Drift Rafts as a custom mechanic that detects raft riding and toasts
Invented the Lily Rush twist mechanic: every 6 seeds grants highjump + speed burst with banner, sfx and sparkles
Removed the duplicate ALONG helper and the enemies count from rules (enemies now come from level.hazards)
known_issues: The raft movers use mesh:null; Gameplay animates them but the visible raft mesh may be minimal — the rip-current zones and ride-detection still work
Autopilot prefers the stepping-rock route and only occasionally rides a raft, so the Rip Current rule fires less often than Lily Rush in bot runs (it fires reliably for a human who hops onto a raft)
